description: Search live used cars for sale from UK dealers on Autoza, with current asking prices in GBP and mileage in miles. Returns a canonical autoza.co.uk URL, the town or area, and the vehicle type for each result. Searches cars unless vehicle_type asks for vans, motorcycles or other stock. If nothing matches every filter, optional filters are relaxed one at a time and the response lists which ones. A result whose dealer title says SOLD, SALE AGREED or DEPOSIT PAID carries availability_caution; a result with no asking price has price_gbp null, and price_note flags a very low price that may be for parts or accessories rather than a vehicle. Use when someone wants to find, browse or compare actual vehicles currently for sale in the UK.

body_type.description: One of hatchback, saloon, suv, coupe, convertible, estate, mpv, pickup, van. Anything else is refused. For motorbikes, vans or motorhomes use vehicle_type.

fuel_type.description: e.g. "petrol", "diesel", "electric", "hybrid", "plug-in hybrid" (also "PHEV"). A plug-in hybrid is not counted as a hybrid.

location.description: UK town, city or postcode district, e.g. "Manchester", "Bury", "SK4". A city matches its postcode areas, as its /cars/{city} page does.

make.description: Manufacturer, e.g. "BMW", "Ford". Everyday names such as "VW" or "Merc" are understood, and the response says how the name was read (make_interpreted_as).

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle type. Defaults to "car". Results are filtered on the vehicle type each listing is recorded under. Pass "van", "motorcycle", "motorhome", "truck" or "caravan" for other stock.

name: search_used_cars
title: Search used cars for sale
